data.title: BellRing Brands’ Earnings Beat Undermined by Margin Pressure and Uncertainty; Underperform Rating and $9 Price Target Maintained
data.description:
Yasmine Deswandhy, an analyst from Bank of America Securities, maintained the Sell rating on BellRing Brands. The associated price target remains the same with $9.00.

Yasmine Deswandhy’s rating is based on several factors, despite BellRing Brands posting a quarterly sales and EBITDA beat. The upside was largely volume-driven, while weaker price/mix and inventory-related charges, including reserves and promotional support, pressured gross margin and raised concerns about the quality of earnings. The company also faces stronger competition and increasing input-cost pressure.

BellRing’s broad fiscal 2027 outlook and withdrawal of its prior long-term targets limit visibility into its growth and margin trajectory. Recent leadership changes, including a new CEO and CFO, add uncertainty while management reassesses its strategy and execution priorities. Accordingly, Deswandhy maintains the Underperform rating and an unchanged $9 price target, based on a 7x CY27 EPS valuation, below the $11.01 share price.

According to TipRanks, Deswandhy is a 2-star analyst with an average return of 3.5% and a 75.00% success rate.
